idea-plugin.name: T3 Code
idea-plugin.description:
Use your existing T3 Code server in a docked IDE panel. Connect to or start a shared background server and see the same threads in the desktop app. Send selected code to a thread draft and open referenced files in your IDE.

Screenshots

Connected toolbar
Send selection adds editor code to your draft for review before sending.

Connect to the shared server

Light theme
idea-plugin.change-notes: Added toolbar screenshots to the plugin's Overview and README. The Overview images are included in the plugin and work offline.

action.description: Add the selected code to the current T3 thread draft
